items.t: 男兒事長征，少小幽燕客。  賭勝馬蹄下，由來輕七尺。
items.c: 男儿事长征，少小幽燕客。  赌胜马蹄下，由来轻七尺。
items.p: nán ér shì cháng zhēng , shào xiǎo yōu yān kè .  dǔ shèng mǎ tí xià , yóu lái qīng qī chǐ .

items.en: A man dedicates himself to long expeditions; from youth, a guest of the You and Yan regions. Betting victory beneath horse hooves, he has always regarded his seven-foot body lightly.

items.t: 四月南風大麥黃，棗花未落桐葉長。  青山朝別暮還見，嘶馬出門思舊鄉。
items.c: 四月南风大麦黄，枣花未落桐叶长。  青山朝别暮还见，嘶马出门思旧乡。
items.p: sì yuè nán fēng dà mài huáng , zǎo huā wèi luò tóng yè cháng .  qīng shān zhāo bié mù huán jiàn , sī mǎ chū mén sī jiù xiāng .

items.en: In the fourth month, the south wind blows and barley turns yellow; date blossoms haven't fallen, but paulownia leaves have grown long. Departing green mountains in the morning and seeing them again at dusk; the neighing horse leaves the gate, longing for its old home.

items.t: 主人有酒歡今夕，請奏鳴琴廣陵客。  月照城頭烏半飛，霜淒萬木風入衣。
items.c: 主人有酒欢今夕，请奏鸣琴广陵客。  月照城头乌半飞，霜凄万木风入衣。

items.en: The host has wine to celebrate this evening; please play the zither, guest of Guangling. The moon shines on the city wall where crows fly mid-air; frost chills the myriad trees, and wind enters my clothes.

items.t: 蔡女昔造胡笳聲，一彈一十有八拍。  胡人落淚沾邊草，漢使斷腸對歸客。
items.c: 蔡女昔造胡笳声，一弹一十有八拍。  胡人落泪沾边草，汉使断肠对归客。

items.en: The daughter of Cai once created the melody of the Hujia; one performance spans eighteen stanzas. The Hu people shed tears wetting the border grass; the Han envoy is heartbroken facing the returning guest.

items.t: 南山截竹為篳篥，此樂本自龜茲出。  流傳漢地曲轉奇，涼州胡人為我吹。
items.c: 南山截竹为筚篥，此乐本自龟兹出。  流传汉地曲转奇，凉州胡人为我吹。

items.en: Cutting bamboo from the Southern Mountains to make a Bili flute; this music originally came from Qiuci. Spreading to Han lands, the melody turned wondrous; a Hu person from Liangzhou plays it for me.

items.t: 長相思，在長安。  絡緯秋啼金井闌，微霜淒淒簟色寒。
items.c: 长相思，在长安。  络纬秋啼金井阑，微霜凄凄簟色寒。
items.p: cháng xiāng sī , zài cháng ān .  luò wěi qiū tí jīn jǐng lán , wēi shuāng qī qī diàn sè hán .

items.en: Longing endlessly, in Chang'an. Crickets chirp in autumn by the golden well railing; light frost is chilly, and the bamboo mat feels cold.

items.t: 金樽清酒斗十千，玉盤珍羞直萬錢。  停杯投箸不能食，拔劍四顧心茫然。
items.c: 金樽清酒斗十千，玉盘珍羞直万钱。  停杯投箸不能食，拔剑四顾心茫然。
items.p: jīn zūn qīng jiǔ dǒu shí qiān , yù pán zhēn xiū zhí wàn qián .  tíng bēi tóu zhù bù néng shí , bá jiàn sì gù xīn máng rán .

items.en: Golden goblets of clear wine cost ten thousand per dou; jade plates of delicacies are worth ten thousand coins. I stop my cup, toss my chopsticks, unable to eat; drawing my sword, I look around, my heart bewildered.

items.t: 君不見黃河之水天上來，奔流到海不復回。  君不見高堂明鏡悲白髮，朝如青絲暮成雪。
items.c: 君不见黄河之水天上来，奔流到海不复回。  君不见高堂明镜悲白发，朝如青丝暮成雪。
items.p: jūn bù jiàn huáng hé zhī shuǐ tiān shàng lái , bēn liú dào hǎi bù fù huí .  jūn bù jiàn gāo táng míng jìng bēi bái fà , zhāo rú qīng sī mù chéng xuě .

items.en: Do you not see the waters of the Yellow River coming from the sky, rushing to the ocean never to return? Do you not see the bright mirror in the high hall grieving over white hair, like black silk at dawn turning to snow by dusk?

items.t: 海客談瀛洲，煙濤微茫信難求。  越人語天姥，雲霞明滅或可睹。
items.c: 海客谈瀛洲，烟涛微茫信难求。  越人语天姥，云霞明灭或可睹。
items.p: hǎi kè tán yíng zhōu , yān tāo wēi máng xìn nán qiú .  yuè rén yǔ tiān mǔ , yún xiá míng miè huò kě dǔ .

items.en: Seafarers talk of Yingzhou, but amidst misty waves, it is truly hard to seek. People of Yue speak of Tianmu Mountain; amidst flickering clouds and rosy mists, it might be visible.

items.t: 車轔轔，馬蕭蕭，行人弓箭各在腰。  耶孃妻子走相送，塵埃不見咸陽橋。
items.c: 车轔轔，马萧萧，行人弓箭各在腰。  耶娘妻子走相送，尘埃不见咸阳桥。

items.en: Chariots rattle, horses neigh; marching men have bows and arrows at their waists. Parents, wives, and children run to see them off; dust obscures the Xianyang Bridge.

items.en: Chariots rattle, horses neigh; marching men have bows and arrows at their waists. Parents, wives, and children run to see them off; dust obscures the Xianyang Bridge.

items.t: 三月三日天氣新，長安水邊多麗人。  態濃意遠淑且真，肌理細膩骨肉勻。
items.c: 三月三日天气新，长安水边多丽人。  态浓意远淑且真，肌理细腻骨肉匀。

items.en: On the third day of the third month, the air is fresh; by the waters of Chang'an, there are many beautiful ladies. Their appearance is rich, their bearing distant, virtuous and sincere; skin texture fine and smooth, bones and flesh well-proportioned.

items.t: 少陵野老吞聲哭，春日潛行曲江曲。  江頭宮殿鎖千門，細柳新蒲為誰綠？
items.c: 少陵野老吞声哭，春日潜行曲江曲。  江头宫殿锁千门，细柳新蒲为谁绿？
items.p: shào líng yě lǎo tūn shēng kū , chūn rì qián xíng qǔ jiāng qū .  jiāng tóu gōng diàn suǒ qiān mén , xì liǔ xīn pú wèi shuí lǜ ?

items.en: The rustic old man of Shaoling swallows his sobs, walking secretly in spring by the winding Qujiang River. The palaces by the river have locked their thousand gates; for whom do the fine willows and new reeds turn green?

items.t: 長安城頭頭白烏，夜飛延秋門上呼。  又向人家啄大屋，屋底達官走避胡。
items.c: 长安城头头白乌，夜飞延秋门上呼。  又向人家啄大屋，屋底达官走避胡。
items.p: cháng ān chéng tóu tóu bái wū , yè fēi yán qiū mén shàng hū .  yòu xiàng rén jiā zhuó dà wū , wū dǐ dá guān zǒu bì hú .

items.en: On the walls of Chang'an sits a white-headed crow; it flies at night to the Yanqiu Gate and caws. It pecks at the great houses of people; the high officials inside flee to escape the barbarians.

items.t: 漢家煙塵在東北，漢將辭家破殘賊。  男兒本自重橫行，天子非常賜顏色。
items.c: 汉家烟尘在东北，汉将辞家破残贼。  男儿本自重横行，天子非常赐颜色。
items.p: hàn jiā yān chén zài dōng běi , hàn jiàng cí jiā pò cán zéi .  nán ér běn zì zhòng héng xíng , tiān zǐ fēi cháng cì yán sè .

items.en: The smoke and dust of the Han family are in the northeast; the Han general leaves home to destroy the remnants of the rebels. Men naturally value unhindered action; the Son of Heaven bestows extraordinary favor.

items.t: 白日登山望烽火，黃昏飲馬傍交河。  行人刁斗風沙暗，公主琵琶幽怨多。
items.c: 白日登山望烽火，黄昏饮马傍交河。  行人刁斗风沙暗，公主琵琶幽怨多。
items.p: bái rì dēng shān wàng fēng huǒ , huáng hūn yìn mǎ bàng jiāo hé .  xíng rén diāo dǒu fēng shā àn , gōng zhǔ pí pá yōu yuàn duō .
items.z: ㄅㄞˊ ㄖˋ ㄉㄥ ㄕㄢ ㄨㄤˋ ㄈㄥ ㄏㄨㄛˇ ， ㄏㄨㄤˊ ㄏㄨㄣ ㄧㄣˋ ㄇㄚˇ ㄅㄤˋ ㄐㄧㄠ ㄏㄜˊ 。  ㄒㄧㄥˊ ㄖㄣˊ ㄉㄧㄠ ㄉㄡˇ ㄈㄥ ㄕㄚ ㄢˋ ， ㄍㄨㄥ ㄓㄨˇ ㄆㄧˊ ㄆㄚˊ ㄧㄡ ㄩㄢˋ ㄉㄨㄛ 。
items.en: By day, climbing the mountain to watch for beacon fires; at twilight, watering horses by the Jiao River. Travelers' cooking pots are dimmed by wind and sand; the Princess's pipa is filled with deep sorrow.

items.t: 輪台城頭夜吹角，輪台城北旄頭落。  羽書昨夜過渠黎，單于已在金山西。
items.c: 轮台城头夜吹角，轮台城北旄头落。  羽书昨夜过渠黎，单于已在金山西。
items.p: lún tái chéng tóu yè chuī jiǎo , lún tái chéng běi máo tóu luò .  yǔ shū zuó yè guò qú lí , chán yú yǐ zài jīn shān xī .

items.en: On the walls of Luntai, horns blow at night; north of Luntai, the Pleiades fall. Feathered dispatches passed Quli last night; the Chanyu is already west of the Jinshan Mountains.

items.t: 君不見走馬川行雪海邊，平沙莽莽黃入天。  輪台九月風夜吼，一川碎石大如斗，隨風滿地石亂走。
items.c: 君不见走马川行雪海边，平沙莽莽黄入天。  轮台九月风夜吼，一川碎石大如斗，随风满地石乱走。
items.p: jūn bù jiàn zǒu mǎ chuān xíng xuě hǎi biān , píng shā mǎng mǎng huáng rù tiān .  lún tái jiǔ yuè fēng yè hǒu , yī chuān suì shí dà rú dǒu , suí fēng mǎn dì shí luàn zǒu .

items.en: Do you not see the Zouma River flowing by the Snowy Sea, where flat sands stretch vast and yellow into the sky? In Luntai's ninth month, the wind howls at night; a river of broken stones, big as bushels, tumble chaotically over the ground with the wind.

items.t: 北風捲地白草折，胡天八月即飛雪。  忽如一夜春風來，千樹萬樹梨花開。
items.c: 北风卷地白草折，胡天八月即飞雪。  忽如一夜春风来，千树万树梨花开。
items.p: běi fēng juǎn dì bái cǎo zhé , hú tiān bā yuè jí fēi xuě .  hū rú yī yè chūn fēng lái , qiān shù wàn shù lí huā kāi .

items.en: The north wind sweeps the ground, snapping the white grass; in the Hu sky, snow flies even in the eighth month. Suddenly, as if a night of spring breeze has come, thousands upon thousands of pear trees blossom.

items.t: 主人有酒歡今夕，請奏鳴琴廣陵客。  月照城頭烏半飛，霜淒萬木風入衣。
items.c: 主人有酒欢今夕，请奏鸣琴广陵客。  月照城头乌半飞，霜凄万木风入衣。
items.p: zhǔ rén yǒu jiǔ huān jīn xī , qǐng zòu míng qín guǎng líng kè .  yuè zhào chéng tóu wū bàn fēi , shuāng qī wàn mù fēng rù yī .
items.z: ㄓㄨˇ ㄖㄣˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄐㄧㄡˇ ㄏㄨㄢ ㄐㄧㄣ ㄒㄧ ， ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄗㄡˋ ㄇㄧㄥˊ ㄑㄧㄣˊ ㄍㄨㄤˇ ㄌㄧㄥˊ ㄎㄜˋ 。  ㄩㄝˋ ㄓㄠˋ ㄔㄥˊ ㄊㄡˊ ㄨ ㄅㄢˋ ㄈㄟ ， ㄕㄨㄤ ㄑㄧ ㄨㄢˋ ㄇㄨˋ ㄈㄥ ㄖㄨˋ ㄧ 。
items.en: The host has wine to celebrate this evening; please play the zither, guest of Guangling. The moon shines on the city wall where crows fly mid-air; frost chills the myriad trees, and wind enters my clothes.

items.t: 蔡女昔造胡笳聲，一彈一十有八拍。  胡人落淚沾邊草，漢使斷腸對歸客。
items.c: 蔡女昔造胡笳声，一弹一十有八拍。  胡人落泪沾边草，汉使断肠对归客。
items.p: cài nǚ xī zào hú jiā shēng , yī tán yī shí yǒu bā pāi .  hú rén luò lèi zhān biān cǎo , hàn shǐ duàn cháng duì guī kè .

items.en: The daughter of Cai once created the melody of the Hujia; one performance spans eighteen stanzas. The Hu people shed tears wetting the border grass; the Han envoy is heartbroken facing the returning guest.

items.t: 南山截竹為篳篥，此樂本自龜茲出。  流傳漢地曲轉奇，涼州胡人為我吹。
items.c: 南山截竹为筚篥，此乐本自龟兹出。  流传汉地曲转奇，凉州胡人为我吹。
items.p: nán shān jié zhú wéi bì lì , cǐ yuè běn zì qiū cí chū .  liú chuán hàn dì qǔ zhuǎn qí , liáng zhōu hú rén wèi wǒ chuī .

items.en: Cutting bamboo from the Southern Mountains to make a Bili flute; this music originally came from Qiuci. Spreading to Han lands, the melody turned wondrous; a Hu person from Liangzhou plays it for me.
